name: Memory & Notes
role: User-controlled local notes and explicit memory recall
description: Stores, lists, searches, and deletes user-requested notes in a local JSON file. Saves only on explicit requests, avoids credential-like content, and never claims to remember unsaved information.

best_for: Saving a note when explicitly asked
Finding or recalling a previously saved note
Deleting a saved note when explicitly asked

functions.description: Save user-requested information as a local note.
Retrieve a saved note or remembered item.
Delete a saved note at the user's request.
List and manage the user's local notes.

boundaries: Saving requires an explicit user request; ordinary conversation is not automatically saved.
Credential-like information is excluded. Storage is local JSON with no external synchronization.
